US Supreme Court Rejects Trump's Appeal in E. Jean Carroll Case

The US Supreme Court has declined to hear Donald Trump's appeal concerning the E. Jean Carroll sexual abuse case. This decision upholds a previous jury verdict awarding Carroll $5 million in damages. The court's brief order did not provide an explanation for its refusal to review the case, a common practice when not taking up an appeal.
